# Introduction

Portrait orientation suits venues with narrow easels. Named sizes (`a0`,
`a1`, `a2`) are stored portrait; add `orientation: landscape` to flip them.
Citations work like any Quarto document [@smith2020].

# Methods

Creel survey design follows @jones2021. Body text, lists, and boxes flow
through two columns here.

::: {.poster-box .highlight title="Study area"}
Fifteen reservoirs across the Great Plains, surveyed May–September.
:::
